name: r-bundle-research
description: One entry that enables the plugins an R research project uses on every session: r-project-core, r-targets, r-geospatial, r-reporting, r-code-review and r-package-dev. It ships no skills or hooks of its own -- enabling it enables those, and r-package-dev in turn pulls the r-lib skills it defers to. Add r-bundle-spades or r-bundle-landis instead if the project simulates.
